messages:
sam: quick alert  onboarding smoke failed for CF Pages edge in new customer flow after @redwood/sdk@3.1.0 landed. error: 'TypeError: Redwood.default is not a function' on import in edge handler.mjs

sam: repro: yarn add @redwood/sdk@3.1.0 && in edge file do `import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'` -> throws at cold start. node server runtime is fine.

esther: looked at package.json in the release tag - we switched to a compact exports map to dedupe: "exports": { ".": "./dist/index.js", "./helpers": "./dist/helpers.js" } but the files are CJS-compiled .js and we didn't provide conditional `import`/`require` targets. edges/bundlers ended up resolving the .js as ESM and trying to call default.

li: also saw a couple TS tickets; subpath imports like `@redwood/sdk/helpers` now fail to find declarations because we removed subpath typings when collapsing the exports. editors throw 'Could not find a declaration file for module'.

sam: high friction for new signups hitting quickstart templates. can we patch quickly?

esther: short-term patch: publish 3.1.1 that restores conditional exports with explicit ESM (.mjs) and CJS (.cjs) targets for root and helpers. example: "exports": { ".": { "import": "./dist/esm/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/index.cjs" }, "./helpers": { "import": "./dist/esm/helpers.mjs", "require": "./dist/cjs/helpers.cjs" }, "./package.json": "./package.json" } and set "types" to point at dist/types/index.d.ts which includes helpers.d.ts.

li: i'll prepare the dts changes. our generator produced `export =` shapes for helpers which break default imports; i'll re-run with moduleKind: "es2015" for ESM-friendly declarations and ensure top-level `export default` exists where we expect it.

sam: to avoid regressions, add a small prepublish smoke that does: `node -e "import('@redwood/sdk').then(m=>console.log(typeof m.default))"` and `node -e "console.log(require('@redwood/sdk'))"` and a tsc --noEmit against the built types.

ops-bot: ci: start job exportmap-smoke (id 772)

li: also suggest we add a fast sample-app edge import test in sample-apps CI: matrix job that just `await import('@redwood/sdk')` to fail fast if a future release regresses.

docs-bot: docs: opened PR for a short DX note: "Package exports & edge runtimes" with examples for conditional exports, subpath typings, and bundler quirks. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/212

esther: publishing 3.1.1 now with fixed exports + types. will post npm link when available.

ops-bot: release-3.1.1 build queued (job id r-3312) :rocket:

sam: retesting sample-app onboarding once canary is published. thanks for the quick turnaround.

li: canary published, edge smoke passed locally. also added the prepublish checks in the publish pipeline.

sam: sample-apps edge matrix is green on canary. promoting stable later today. follow-ups:
- add export-map entry to release checklist (esther)
- add edge import smoke to sample-apps CI (li)
- include types sanity check in prepublish (li)
- add DX doc linking examples for node, bundlers, cloudflare, vercel (docs-bot)

sam: lesson: compacting export maps is tempting for tidy packages but can silently break ESM/edge consumers and subpath typings. small prepublish checks + a sample-app edge smoke prevented bigger onboarding churn :thumbsup:
